		   ,#template_string_1
FROM       CUSTOMER MSTR 
LEFT JOIN 
           ( 
				   SELECT CAST(PROF_SK AS STRING)                     AS PROF_SK, 
                         CAST(PROD_SK AS STRING)                     AS PROD_SK, 
                         TIME_BCKT_DATE
						 ,#template_string_1
				  FROM
				  (select 
						PROF_SK
						,PROD_SK
						,#sugg_posted_date AS TIME_BCKT_DATE
						,#template_string_2
